title: FR-40 lane runner keeps Codex-era modules without receiver evidence
body: The FR-40 lane runner (evals/fr40/lanes.ts) still imports src/evals/{mask,receiver,score,session} and src/hosts/systemd-scope.ts, whose evidence tests left with the worker (t-9w41zw0). Either give each a real receiver test or inline what the lane runner needs and delete them.
